title: Post-Collision Velocity v2 in 1D Head-on Elastic Collision
latex: v_2 = \left(\frac{2 m_1}{m_1 + m_2}\right) u_1 + \left(\frac{m_2 - m_1}{m_1 + m_2}\right) u_2

variables.v_2: Final velocity of mass 2 after elastic collision
variables.u_1, u_2: Initial velocities of masses 1 and 2 before collision

validity_conditions: Valid for all classical point spheres colliding head-on elastically
common_misuse: Using (m1 - m2) instead of (m2 - m1) in the second term
Ignoring initial velocity u2 when target is moving
source_provenance: HCV1 Ch 9 p. 166 eq. 9.23; HRW Ch 9 p. 247; UP Ch 8 p. 280
equation_latex: v_2 = \left(\frac{2 m_1}{m_1 + m_2}\right) u_1 + \left(\frac{m_2 - m_1}{m_1 + m_2}\right) u_2
